content_sections.text: Environmental sample collection specialist : 12th pass in science subjects and two years diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician or one-year DMLT with one year required experience in a recognized organization or two years' field/ laboratory experience (BSc degree shall be treated as 3 years experience).

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DRRMLIMS Environmental sample collection specialist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences (DRRMLIMS), Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh for a project-based healthcare position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Environmental sample collection specialist under the UNICEF-funded project LEAD-UP at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Environmental sample collection specialist position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for DRRMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position is purely based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by the institute on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Environmental sample collection specialist post is scheduled to be held on 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th in science subjects along with a two-year diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician or a one-year DMLT with relevant experience, or a BSc degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Environmental sample collection specialist post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Environmental sample collection specialist post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 24,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational and experience certificates along with one set of self-attested photocopies and recent passport-size photographs.
